Build Stan input for the time-varying VE model

Source: R/stan.R
make_stan_data.Rd

Aggregates person-days into cells of age group x vaccination status x day x day since vaccination, and attaches the force-of-infection offset.

Usage

make_stan_data(person_days, foi, max_days_since_vax = NULL)

Arguments

person_days

Output of expand_person_days().

foi

Output of force_of_infection().

max_days_since_vax

Last day since vaccination with its own bin. Defaults to the longest observed.

Value

A list with two elements:

cells: a tibble with one row per cell, i.e. per combination of age group, vaccination status, study day and day since vaccination that has any person-time:

age_group

Age group (factor).

vax_status

1 if the person-days are after vaccination, 0 if before vaccination or never vaccinated.

day

Study (calendar) day.

tvax_bin

Day-since-vaccination bin: 1 for unvaccinated person-days, t + 1 for day t after vaccination.

Y

Number of reported cases (events) in the cell.

n_persdays

Person-days at risk in the cell.

Ibar

Force-of-infection offset for that day and age group, from foi.

data: the list passed to Stan, built from cells (same row order):

N

Number of cells.

K

Number of age groups (declared in the Stan models but not used).

T_vax

Number of day-since-vaccination bins, max_days_since_vax + 1.

Y

cells$Y.

log_Ibar, log_persdays

Logs of cells$Ibar and cells$n_persdays, used as offsets.

vax, tvax_bin

cells$vax_status and cells$tvax_bin.

Details

Days since vaccination are binned by day: bin 1 is unvaccinated, bin t + 1 is day t after vaccination. Days beyond max_days_since_vax share the last bin.
